scope.notes: Changed the hero copy and moved the demo form on /demo. Rewrote the page's H1 on purpose.

checks.name: Form 1000 loads
checks.evidence: The form showed all 7 fields within 3 seconds.

checks.name: Form 1000 real submission
checks.evidence: Form showed 'Submission failed, please try again later.' No lead in Marketo after 5 minutes.
checks.cause: The form embed moved outside the element its script looks for.
checks.fix: Move the embed back inside .hero-form, then publish to dev and run the check again.
